name: ambrook
description: Read Ambrook records and financial reports from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Ambrook account to ask questions about your business books. Review transactions, unpaid invoices, upcoming bills, profit and loss, and balance sheets. Explore accounts, contacts, and bookkeeping tags, retrieve reports and attachments, and find Ambrook help articles. Follow links to view records in Ambrook. This connection provides read-only access to the organizations you can access in Ambrook. It cannot change records, send payments, or make purchases. An Ambrook account with MCP access is required.
defaultPrompt: Compare my cash-basis profit and loss for the last two complete months.
Show my unpaid invoices and the total customers owe me.
Show my unpaid bills due in the next 30 days, including overdue bills.

prompts: Which Ambrook businesses can I access, and which one is my default?
Compare my cash-basis profit and loss for the last two complete months and explain the three biggest changes.
How much do customers owe me? Show the 10 unpaid invoices due soonest, with customer, amount still owed, and due date.
Show unpaid bills due in the next 30 days, including overdue bills, and the total still owed. List the 10 due soonest.
Show my 10 most recent transactions missing a category and any suggested categories Ambrook has for them.
Export last month's detailed cash-basis profit and loss to Excel.
Export an accrual-basis balance sheet as of October 31, 2026 as a PDF.
Export my all-time cash-basis profit and loss as CSV.

positive.description: Detailed financial statement export. Use a dedicated sample-data account with recorded cash transactions in the last complete calendar month. Provide the export_financial_report schema to the test connection explicitly while it remains absent from discovery. Verify fixture values before execution; this plugin review case has not been run live.
positive.prompt: Export last month's detailed cash-basis profit and loss to Excel.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the business and last complete calendar month from whoami. Call export_financial_report with orgId, report=profit_loss, basis=CASH, detail=detailed, format=Excel, and inclusive period.start and period.end. Present the returned Excel resource and filename, state the effective business, dates and basis, and do not invent totals or an attachment. If the connection cannot invoke the tool, explain the limitation or use an advertised tool that supports the requested export.

positive.description: Point-in-time financial statement export. Use a dedicated sample-data account with known accrual balances on October 31, 2026 and provide the financial export schema to the test connection. Verify fixture balances before execution; this plugin review case has not been run live.
positive.prompt: Export an accrual-basis balance sheet as of October 31, 2026 as a PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve orgId, then call export_financial_report with report=balance_sheet, basis=ACCRUAL, format=Pdf and period={end:2026-10-31}. Omit period.start and allTime, and use summary detail by default. Present only the returned PDF resource or signed-in download link, with its effective as-of date and basis. Do not claim success if the tool is unavailable or returns an error.

positive.description: Oversized financial export delivery. Provide the financial export schema to the test connection and use a dedicated sample organization whose all-time CSV exceeds the 5 MiB inline limit. Confirm fixture size before execution; this plugin review case has not been run live.
positive.prompt: Export my all-time cash-basis profit and loss as CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve orgId, then call export_financial_report with report=profit_loss, basis=CASH, format=Csv and period={allTime:true}. For status=size_limit_exceeded, share the returned downloadUrl and explain that it regenerates the CSV for the selected business in a browser signed in to Ambrook. Do not change formats, attempt to fetch the link with another integration, claim the CSV was returned inline, or mistake this fallback for an empty report.

positive.description: Identity and organization discovery. Use a dedicated Ambrook sample-data account with external MCP enabled and one accessible default organization. If multiple organizations are returned, select the sample organization before continuing. Seed recorded transactions in the last two complete calendar months, unpaid invoices with different due dates, unpaid bills both overdue and due within the next 30 days, and at least one transaction missing a category. Confirm fixture values in Ambrook before execution; no fixture data has been created or verified yet.
positive.prompt: Which Ambrook businesses can I access, and which one is my default?
positive.expected_behavior: Call whoami with {}. List only returned organizations, show the returned defaultOrganizationId when present, and ask which organization to use if more than one is available. Do not invent an organization or fetch another organization before selection.

positive.description: Two-month financial comparison using authoritative statement totals rather than transaction sums. Use a dedicated Ambrook sample-data account with external MCP enabled and one accessible default organization. If multiple organizations are returned, select the sample organization before continuing. Seed recorded transactions in the last two complete calendar months, unpaid invoices with different due dates, unpaid bills both overdue and due within the next 30 days, and at least one transaction missing a category. Confirm fixture values in Ambrook before execution; no fixture data has been created or verified yet.
positive.prompt: Compare my cash-basis profit and loss for the last two complete months and explain the three biggest changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve calendar months using the selected organization timezone and todaysDate from whoami. Call query_profit_and_loss with its orgId, basis=CASH, groupBy=Month, start at the first day of the earlier month and end at the final day of the later month. Use returned row/column relationships and cents values to calculate changes, format dollars correctly, and state dates and basis. Report only supported changes; explain missing data without inventing totals.

positive.description: Accounts receivable with exact filtered totals and a bounded oldest-due page. Use a dedicated Ambrook sample-data account with external MCP enabled and one accessible default organization. If multiple organizations are returned, select the sample organization before continuing. Seed recorded transactions in the last two complete calendar months, unpaid invoices with different due dates, unpaid bills both overdue and due within the next 30 days, and at least one transaction missing a category. Confirm fixture values in Ambrook before execution; no fixture data has been created or verified yet.
positive.prompt: How much do customers owe me? Show the 10 unpaid invoices due soonest, with customer, amount still owed, and due date.
positive.expected_behavior: After resolving orgId, call list_invoices with section=Unpaid, first=10 and sort={columnId:Due,direction:ASC}. Use totals.unpaidAmountCents across the full filtered set instead of summing the returned page. Display returned invoices only, format remaining amounts from cents and preserve organization-local due dates. Link returned record ids with get_app_links; do not construct ids. If there are no matches, explicitly report that.

positive.description: Accounts payable calendar boundary including overdue bills, not only future dates. Use a dedicated Ambrook sample-data account with external MCP enabled and one accessible default organization. If multiple organizations are returned, select the sample organization before continuing. Seed recorded transactions in the last two complete calendar months, unpaid invoices with different due dates, unpaid bills both overdue and due within the next 30 days, and at least one transaction missing a category. Confirm fixture values in Ambrook before execution; no fixture data has been created or verified yet.
positive.prompt: Show unpaid bills due in the next 30 days, including overdue bills, and the total still owed. List the 10 due soonest.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve orgId and today in the organization timezone. Call list_bills with section=Unpaid, dueBefore=today plus 30 calendar days, first=10, sort={columnId:Due,direction:ASC}, and no dueAfter bound so overdue bills remain included. Use totals.unpaidAmountCents for all matches, state the through-date and present vendor, amount still owed, and due date for returned bills. Convert cents accurately and link only returned ids using get_app_links. State no matches when applicable.

positive.description: Missing-category filter followed by detail inspection for unapplied category suggestions. Use a dedicated Ambrook sample-data account with external MCP enabled and one accessible default organization. If multiple organizations are returned, select the sample organization before continuing. Seed recorded transactions in the last two complete calendar months, unpaid invoices with different due dates, unpaid bills both overdue and due within the next 30 days, and at least one transaction missing a category. Confirm fixture values in Ambrook before execution; no fixture data has been created or verified yet.
positive.prompt: Show my 10 most recent transactions missing a category and any suggested categories Ambrook has for them.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve orgId, then call list_transactions with first=10, fullyTagged={category:false}, and sort={columnId:Date,direction:DSC}. Read returned transactions and pagination, including transactionAmountCents. Call get_transaction for returned ids as needed to inspect pendingCategorySuggestion; use lineItemId to distinguish line suggestions. Present suggestions as unapplied. Use get_app_links for returned record ids. Do not claim categories were changed, infer complete tagging from appliedTags, or invent suggestions.

negative.description: Unsupported financial export options. Do not send a start date for a balance sheet or silently discard grouping/comparison requests. Explain the unsupported options and clarify the desired as-of statement, or use an advertised tool that supports the requested comparison. Do not fabricate a file.
negative.prompt: Export a cash-basis balance sheet from January 1 through December 31, 2025, grouped by month with prior-year comparisons.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides read-only access to an existing Ambrook account. It does not initiate purchases, subscriptions, or payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds financial statement export guidance and review cases for explicit accounting bases, date scopes, file formats, and signed-in download links for large files. Financial export tool availability depends on the connection.
